title: Broadcom Powers Telia's Modernization with VMware, Launches AI-Driven VeloRAIN & More
description: Broadcom expands its partnership with Telia to modernize telecom and cloud infrastructure using VMware's cloud-native architecture. Broadcom also launches new products like VeloRAIN to enhance AI workload support and the Titan Partner Program to aid enterprise AI growth.

title: Broadcom Enhances Open-Source Ecosystem with Bitnami Premium Release
description: Broadcom launched Bitnami Premium, a commercial enterprise version of Bitnami by VMware Tanzu, to enhance security for open-source software use in enterprise applications. Arrow Electronics will distribute Bitnami Premium globally, offering compliance tools and production-grade software.
